alcohol.answer: Virgin Australia permits alcohol in carry-on or checked baggage in retail packaging, up to a maximum net total of 5 litres per person and not above 70% alcohol. You may not drink alcohol you carry on board.

sections.h: 🍷 What Virgin Australia says about alcohol
sections.p: From the Virgin Australia Dangerous goods page, read on 22 November 2026.

head: Question
Virgin Australia rule
rows: Maximum net total of 5 litres per person
Must not be more than 70% alcohol by volume
Not permitted for alcohol you carry
Liquid, aerosol and gel limits apply in carry-on; the page refers to the Department of Infrastructure

list: Not on the page: this page gives no separate rule for drinks of 24% or less.

faq: How much alcohol can I take on Virgin Australia?
A maximum net total of 5 litres per person, in retail packaging, and no more than 70% alcohol by volume.
Can I drink my own alcohol on a Virgin Australia flight?
No. The Dangerous goods page says consumption of alcohol carried on board is not permitted.
